title: Equality of the canonical ordered source descents
statement: For a commutative ring A annihilated by N, a normalized finite twist transport t, a scheme Y on which N is invertible, an ordinary derived coefficient complex K and a rank d, the explicitly recursive descent in OrdinaryAffineCounitTensorNormalization [def-pur-ordinary-affine-counit-tensor-maps] equals ordinarySourceDescent [def-pur-affine-ordered-counit-data]. Both are isomorphisms from the ordered right-adjoint source to the pullback of K tensored with the ordered base coefficient.

source.place: Final paragraph, ordered affine-space integration and canonical reassociations; expanded ordered-transpose proof Steps 5 and 6.

proof.text: Apply ordinaryFiniteTensorTrace_app to the identity of the coefficient unit. Its tensor map is identity, so this trace is the derived right unitor. Extensionality of isomorphisms identifies its inverse with the inverse unitor, giving equality of the zero clauses.

For an arbitrary predecessor source isomorphism e, apply naturality of the inverse of leftDerivedUpperStarComp to the tensor associator. Precompose with the common line-descent and tensor-pullback maps. This moves the associator from inside the iterated pullback to after the pullback compositor, exactly identifying descentStep and ordinaryDescentStepRaw.

Use the zero and successor properties supplied by ordinarySourceDescent_existsUnique. Induct on d, applying the zero comparison and then the successor comparison and induction hypothesis. Equality of hom maps gives equality of isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Elementary comparison of the two fixed source-descent recursions in the ordered coefficient-counit step; extracted from the proved G8 comparison solely to keep each Lean file within the compilation limit.

Nine hits including NatTrans.naturality. Its naturality square is used at the inverse pullback-composition comparison to identify the successor clauses. No result packages the project-specific source recursion.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_source_descent (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (d : ℕ) :
    Etale.OrdinaryAffineCounitTensorNormalization.descent A N hA t Y hY d K =
      ordinarySourceDescent A N hA t Y hY K d
